vetSays.line: 👥 A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." Better close to the fire today.
👥 A man, maybe 40s, with a gap-toothed grin walks out with A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek. "Nobody walks alone today."
"You haven't earned that yet," A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek says. (Trust too low.)
💧 A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +3 clean.
🚶 A man, maybe 40s, with a gap-toothed grin is back with A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek.
A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." Company makes the road shorter.
"You haven't earned that yet," A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek says. (Trust too low.)
...and then it lands: A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
🛡️ Mariana, Ella, Ye-jin, Mateo and Victor met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Mariana, Ella, Ye-jin, Mateo, Victor are hurt.
🛡️ Ella, Ye-jin, Nathan and Victor met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Ella, Ye-jin, Nathan, Victor are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Meera just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Meera, Mariana, Ella and Ye-jin met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Meera, Mariana, Ella, Ye-jin are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mariana just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mateo just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Meera just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Meera, Ella, Nathan and Victor met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Meera, Nathan, Victor are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
Meera strikes the Scarred Static.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
The Scarred Static falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred Static!
📺 You brought down Scarred Static. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 You brought down Scarred Static.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Rosa just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Oliver just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
